csu-sarcoma-engineered-tcells.identity: Institutional named protocol 5269 is STS only. General Flint master and older listing include osteosarcoma but no OSA cohort may be inferred here. Autologous engineered IV CAR-T after oral conditioning; may receive oral immunotherapy. Surgery or repeat biopsy about 1 week later.
csu-sarcoma-engineered-tcells.recruitment_sites: Current native and rendered institutional patient recruitment. CSU Veterinary Health System, 300 W Drake Rd, Fort Collins, CO
csu-sarcoma-engineered-tcells.eligibility: Confirmed biopsiable canine STS, at least 11 kg, adequate bloodwork, no anticancer treatment in previous 2 weeks, no prior immunotherapy, no uncontrolled immune disease, all CSU visits.
csu-sarcoma-engineered-tcells.funding: Up to $3,200 study treatment; $2,000 toward surgery or other treatment; oral immunotherapy except dispensing; up to $500 treatment-related side effects. Initial exam/diagnostic testing and remaining surgery owner-paid; screening assistance available.
csu-sarcoma-engineered-tcells.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; 6–8 weeks participation.

csu-osa-car-t-met.identity: IACUC 3398 independent from CSU STS 5269 and Penn metastatic CAR-iNKT cutoff. Autologous engineered IV CAR-T after two days conditioning chemotherapy; daily oral meds and rechecks days 1, 3, 7, 14, 28 and 60.
csu-osa-car-t-met.recruitment_sites: Current native and rendered institutional patient recruitment. CSU Veterinary Health System, 300 W Drake Rd, Fort Collins, CO
csu-osa-car-t-met.eligibility: Canine limb OSA removed surgically, metastases limited to lungs and visible on chest x-rays, at least 20 kg, adequate bloodwork, no chemo in past 2–3 weeks or current steroids/immunomodulators.
csu-osa-car-t-met.funding: Owner pays initial exam/diagnostics and study visit exam fees; study pays other study-related treatment, diagnostics and labs, up to $2,000 for protocol side effects; screening assistance possible.
csu-osa-car-t-met.deadline: No published recruitment end; approximately 60-day participation.

mizzou-pulmonary-carcinoma-gilvetmab.identity: Exact Missouri monoimmunotherapy with gilvetmab every 2 weeks for up to 10 doses for primary pulmonary carcinoma, distinct from metastasis studies.
mizzou-pulmonary-carcinoma-gilvetmab.recruitment_sites: Official named currently enrolling subsection, Columbia Missouri; all study visits there.
mizzou-pulmonary-carcinoma-gilvetmab.eligibility: Dogs with gross or microscopic disease; no immune-mediated disease, severe comorbidities, or concurrent steroids or other immunosuppressants. Initial screening needed.
mizzou-pulmonary-carcinoma-gilvetmab.funding: Study pays gilvetmab ($540–$1,350 per treatment estimate); owner pays rechecks, labs and chest imaging.
mizzou-pulmonary-carcinoma-gilvetmab.deadline: No published recruitment deadline; up to 10 biweekly visits is duration.

mizzou-feline-highgrade-lymphoma-wart.identity: Exact high-grade/large-cell feline GI lymphoma, WART followed by COP/doxorubicin, distinct from small-cell CSU and TAMU radiation protocols.
mizzou-feline-highgrade-lymphoma-wart.recruitment_sites: Current official individual subsection, University of Missouri VHC, Columbia; all study visits at that site.
mizzou-feline-highgrade-lymphoma-wart.eligibility: Cat with cytology/histology confirmed high-grade GI lymphoma and no extra-abdominal lymphoma, previous chemo, FeLV/FIV or severe anesthetic-risk disease.
mizzou-feline-highgrade-lymphoma-wart.funding: Radiation plus $1,000 VHC stipend after RT; screening, chemo, other care and travel coverage not specified.
mizzou-feline-highgrade-lymphoma-wart.deadline: No published intake cutoff; visits weekly then every three weeks.

ncsu-liver-inspire.identity: NC State Mike Sano electroporation INSPIRE, with surgical and nonsurgical arms; distinct from NC State mammary INSPIRE.
ncsu-liver-inspire.recruitment_sites: Current NC State named oncology listing, patient protocol and linked flyer. Single North Carolina State Veterinary Hospital, Raleigh.
ncsu-liver-inspire.eligibility: Dog ≥30 lb with 1–2 liver tumors 1–8 cm, cytology prior to screening, no metastasis or other cancer, no major heart disease/arrhythmia or contraindicating illness.
ncsu-liver-inspire.funding: Flyer says fully funded; includes consult, study bloodwork, CT, ECG/echo, FNA/pathology and lobectomy if assigned.
ncsu-liver-inspire.deadline: Published enrollment July 1, 2023–July 1, 2027; date future at current visit.

utsw-vroc-glioma-car-neutrophils-rt.identity: VCT25005903 and exact UT Southwestern Study 6. Randomized CAR-neutrophil injection versus no injection; assigned radiation modality (fractionated, SRT or Pulsar).
utsw-vroc-glioma-car-neutrophils-rt.recruitment_sites: Current VROC listing and exact registry protocol, single Dallas site.
utsw-vroc-glioma-car-neutrophils-rt.eligibility: Dogs with MRI-suspected or biopsy/surgery-confirmed glioma, primary or postsurgical recurrence; no previous tumor radiation or concurrent chemotherapy/other immunotherapy; ≥2-week chemotherapy washout, steroids/anticonvulsants may continue; stop antioxidant supplements. Brochure lists ability to receive prednisone; center screening controls.
utsw-vroc-glioma-car-neutrophils-rt.funding: Study-subsidized; scheduled imaging/follow-up covered; owners pay tests and care outside the study. NIH 1R01CA293514-01A1.
utsw-vroc-glioma-car-neutrophils-rt.deadline: Exact rendered AVMA recruitment 2025-05-30 through 2029-06-01 (Dallas local time).

utsw-vroc-glioma-ferumoxytol-rt.identity: VCT25005902 and exact UT Southwestern Study 7. Ferumoxytol nanoparticle infusions and stereotactic radiation 3×8 Gy, distinct Study 7 intervention.
utsw-vroc-glioma-ferumoxytol-rt.recruitment_sites: Current VROC listing and exact registry protocol, single Dallas site.
utsw-vroc-glioma-ferumoxytol-rt.eligibility: Dogs with MRI-suspected or biopsy/surgery-confirmed glioma, primary or postsurgical recurrence; no previous tumor radiation or concurrent chemotherapy/other immunotherapy; ≥2-week chemotherapy washout, steroids/anticonvulsants may continue; stop antioxidant supplements. Brochure lists ability to receive prednisone; center screening controls.
utsw-vroc-glioma-ferumoxytol-rt.funding: May be fully or partially subsidized per Study 7 flyer; owners may pay diagnostics, imaging, palliative and other care outside study. Government funding does not guarantee full subsidy.
utsw-vroc-glioma-ferumoxytol-rt.deadline: Exact rendered AVMA recruitment 2025-05-30 through 2027-06-01 (Dallas local time).

uf-osa-vaccine.identity: Post-amputation six-dose UF vaccine plus six chemotherapy visits; distinct from UF radiation and RNA-NP
uf-osa-vaccine.recruitment_sites: Exact UF individual protocol and currently listed institution; Gainesville, Florida.
uf-osa-vaccine.eligibility: Newly diagnosed untreated limb OSA without other life-threatening disease; requires UF amputation and tumor sampling; excludes zoledronate and concurrent OSA trial.
uf-osa-vaccine.funding: Owner pays workup/amputation, chemo, all six vaccines and visits; only injection site reaction up to $100 covered.
uf-osa-vaccine.contacts: UF Oncology clinical team, 352-392-2235; official study interest path.
uf-osa-vaccine.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; treatment/recheck schedule only.

uf-osa-mrna.identity: RNA-nanoparticle vaccine plus anti-PD-1 with radiation, not the post-amputation chemotherapy protocol
uf-osa-mrna.recruitment_sites: Exact UF individual protocol and currently listed institution; Gainesville, Florida.
uf-osa-mrna.eligibility: Microscopically confirmed limb OSA with UF pre-RT biopsy during planning CT; radiation required; mild metastases investigator discretion; no zoledronate or competing OSA trial.
uf-osa-mrna.funding: Study vaccine production, exams, protocol lab tests and vaccine-day adverse events covered; standard workup and radiation owner-paid except selected grants. Up to $1,000 for immediate anaphylaxis.
uf-osa-mrna.contacts: UF Oncology clinical team, 352-392-2235; official study interest path.
uf-osa-mrna.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; treatment/recheck schedule only.

selection_cases.osa_location: Axial — skull, spine, rib, or pelvis

uf-hsa-vaccine.identity: UF vaccine and doxorubicin after splenectomy for splenic HSA.
uf-hsa-vaccine.recruitment_sites: Exact UF individual protocol and currently listed institution; Gainesville, Florida.
uf-hsa-vaccine.eligibility: Newly diagnosed untreated splenic HSA, splenectomy and doxorubicin suitability; staging 10–16 days and first chemo 14–17 days after surgery.
uf-hsa-vaccine.funding: Owner pays vaccines (~$1,275 for six), consultations, surgery, diagnostics and chemo; $100 max for injection-site reaction only.
uf-hsa-vaccine.contacts: UF Oncology clinical team, 352-392-2235; official study interest path.
uf-hsa-vaccine.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; treatment/recheck schedule only.

uf-melanoma.identity: UF melanoma vaccine-only series with optional boosters, distinct from unexcised oral melanoma GD2/3 plus gilvetmab.
uf-melanoma.recruitment_sites: Exact UF individual protocol and currently listed institution; Gainesville, Florida.
uf-melanoma.eligibility: Recently diagnosed canine malignant melanoma, resectable or minimal, no major life-threatening disease.
uf-melanoma.funding: Owner pays initial evaluation, vaccines, subsequent visits and boosters. No guaranteed subsidy.
uf-melanoma.contacts: UF Oncology clinical team, 352-392-2235; official study interest path.
uf-melanoma.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; treatment/recheck schedule only.

uf-feline-oscc.identity: UF currently listed Milner personal RNA-NP vaccine for feline oral SCC; linked current protocol uses three administrations over nine weeks. An older Carlos Souza route presents a seven-week schedule, not applied to the currently linked protocol.
uf-feline-oscc.recruitment_sites: Exact UF individual protocol and currently listed institution; Gainesville, Florida.
uf-feline-oscc.eligibility: Histology and staging-confirmed feline oral SCC, naive tumor sample before standard care; exclude advanced local/metastatic disease, other major diseases, subject to investigator medication/washout review.
uf-feline-oscc.funding: Current protocol covers three vaccine visits, study exams and lab work, immune monitoring, supportive care, 1- and 3-month rechecks and boosters. Evaluation and standard SCC treatment owner-paid.
uf-feline-oscc.contacts: UF Oncology clinical team, 352-392-2235; official study interest path.
uf-feline-oscc.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; treatment/recheck schedule only.

uf-oral-melanoma-vaccine-pd1.identity: Exact GD2/3 vaccine and IV gilvetmab (four cycles), distinct from UF vaccine-only cohort.
uf-oral-melanoma-vaccine-pd1.recruitment_sites: Exact UF individual protocol and currently listed institution; Gainesville, Florida.
uf-oral-melanoma-vaccine-pd1.eligibility: Newly diagnosed canine resectable or minimal oral malignant melanoma that has not been excised; excludes major life-threatening disease; protocol biopsy.
uf-oral-melanoma-vaccine-pd1.funding: Anti-PD1 drug and study tissue biopsies covered. Owner pays vaccine, screening, later visits and other costs.
uf-oral-melanoma-vaccine-pd1.contacts: UF Oncology clinical team, 352-392-2235; official study interest path.
uf-oral-melanoma-vaccine-pd1.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; treatment/recheck schedule only.

uf-boxer-glioma-autogenic-vaccine.identity: Exact Carrera-Justiz tumor-derived RNA autogenic vaccine after CT-guided biopsy, three weekly vaccines.
uf-boxer-glioma-autogenic-vaccine.recruitment_sites: Exact UF individual protocol and currently listed institution; Gainesville, Florida.
uf-boxer-glioma-autogenic-vaccine.eligibility: Boxers only, suspect malignant glioma on MRI, no previous tumor treatment or other life-threatening disease. Breed requires screening.
uf-boxer-glioma-autogenic-vaccine.funding: CT-guided biopsy and lymph node removal with anesthesia/recovery, study vaccines and sample analyses covered. Other visit costs discussed individually.
uf-boxer-glioma-autogenic-vaccine.contacts: UF Neurology clinical team, 352-392-2235; official study interest path.
uf-boxer-glioma-autogenic-vaccine.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; treatment/recheck schedule only.
